justification: Inspected `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/utility/privilege/GetSystemPropertyAction.java` and `byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/utility/privilege/GetSystemPropertyActionTest.java`. The class is only 48 lines long and contains one field (`key`), one constructor, and one `run()` method that պարզապես returns `System.getProperty(key)`. The test covers only this single behavior. There is no evidence of multiple responsibilities, large size, many public methods, or separable concerns, so insufficient modularization is not present.
